name: Forwarder Inbox Agent
idea: Reads freight forwarders' emailed booking orders with Excel/PDF attachments and enters them into a mock TMS, holding low-confidence fields for review.
twist: Learns new shipping-line templates on the fly when Laem Chabang carriers change formats, flagging Thai-English mixed fields instead of guessing.

name: Port Shock Re-router
idea: Watches port delays, congestion news and tariff changes, then re-plans Thai exporters' shipments across ports, airfreight or delay, within a cost budget.
twist: Handles sudden US tariff announcements by repricing durian, rubber and electronics orders per HS code before the vessel cut-off.

name: Pre-Load Parcel Scanner
idea: Scans line-haul manifests before trucks are loaded, flagging lithium batteries, liquids and mismatched declarations, and re-sorts flagged parcels automatically.
twist: Updates its banned-item rules for festival peaks, like fireworks before Loy Krathong, without retraining.

name: น้ำมา Rescue Router
idea: Turns Thai flood posts on LINE OpenChat and Facebook into geotagged rescue requests and assigns boats and volunteers along passable routes.
twist: Re-plans routes every time a road gauge or new post says a street went under, deduplicating repeated pleas for the same family.

name: เขื่อนปล่อยน้ำ Alert
idea: Monitors mock dam-release notices and river gauges and pushes village-level evacuation alerts with time-to-arrival estimates.
twist: Speaks alerts in Northern, Isan or Southern dialect and tightens thresholds automatically when the rainfall forecast jumps.

name: Highway Crash Triage
idea: Voice-guides bystanders at highway bus crashes through START triage and streams a live casualty count to 1669 dispatch.
twist: Switches from triage to fire-safety guidance if bystanders report smoke, a common factor in Thai double-decker bus accidents.

name: Songkran ER Balancer
idea: Simulates emergency department load across nearby hospitals and recommends ambulance diversions before any one ER overflows.
twist: Built for the 'seven dangerous days' of Songkran and New Year, re-planning hourly as drunk-driving crash reports spike.

name: Heat Watch for Elders
idea: Scores heat vulnerability per community and schedules village health volunteer check-in calls for elders living alone.
twist: Reprioritises the call list when the heat-index forecast shifts, and escalates elders who stop answering to a home visit.

name: Rider Fall Detector
idea: Uses phone motion and location to detect ShopeeFood rider crashes, runs a Thai voice check-in, and calls 1669 if no answer.
twist: Learns Bangkok pothole and speed-bump signatures per route so it stops false alarms without missing real falls.

name: Scam Ad Honeybot
idea: A supervised honeybot chats with fake gold and forex investment ads, collecting mule accounts and LINE IDs as an evidence pack for police.
twist: Adapts its persona as scammers switch scripts, and stops before any real money moves, which a human officer must approve.

name: ShopeePay Agent Mandate
idea: Checks that an AI shopping agent paying through a ShopeePay-style wallet carries a valid passport and spend mandate before releasing funds.
twist: Tightens limits automatically when an agent's buying pattern drifts, like sudden bulk orders of gold or top-up cards.

name: Thai Dialect Crash-Test
idea: An adversary agent posing as Thai buyers runs thousands of chats against a seller bot, and a judge agent issues a reliability label.
twist: Personas speak Isan, Southern, slang and Thai-English mix, exposing bots that only work in textbook Thai.

name: Garena Answer Gate
idea: Two models cross-check every game-support bot answer about top-ups and bans against policy before it reaches a player.
twist: Auto-pauses topics where disagreement spikes right after a patch, routing those tickets to staff until docs update.

name: 9.9 Incident Commander
idea: Opens payment-outage incidents, pages on-call engineers, correlates logs and drafts Thai and English status updates on its own.
twist: Re-assigns the incident lead when root cause moves from bank gateway to PromptPay, keeping merchants informed in plain Thai.

name: Mega-Sale Cloud Right-Sizer
idea: Forecasts traffic for double-date sales and esports finals, pre-scales cloud capacity, then scales down and reports carbon saved.
twist: Detects surprise spikes, such as a viral Thai celebrity live, and re-forecasts within minutes instead of waiting for alarms.

name: Flaky Checkout Healer
idea: Generates synthetic Thai test data and quarantines flaky checkout tests, proposing fixes with Codex.
twist: Synthetic data covers messy Thai addresses (หมู่, ซอย, ตำบล) and Buddhist-era dates, the inputs that actually break checkout.

name: Rice Mill Maintenance Crew
idea: Five agents watch community rice-mill sensor logs, read Chinese and Thai manufacturer PDFs, and raise repair work orders.
twist: Defers non-urgent repairs during harvest peak and pre-orders parts when the mill's run hours surge.

name: Island Microgrid Agent
idea: Balances solar, battery and diesel for an island grid serving resorts and homes, scheduling loads to avoid blackouts.
twist: Adapts to monsoon cloud cover and tourist high-season loads on islands like Koh Tao, protecting clinics first.

name: หมู่บ้าน Solar Swap
idea: Lets households in a Thai housing estate auto-trade surplus rooftop solar with neighbours at a fair internal price.
twist: Re-prices automatically when the utility tariff (Ft) changes and pauses trades during grid outages.

name: EV Rider Charge Planner
idea: Books battery-swap and charging slots for electric delivery riders based on their order queue and battery level.
twist: Re-plans instantly when a swap station goes offline or rain floods a route, keeping riders earning.

name: AWD Paddy Agent
idea: Controls irrigation pumps for alternate wetting and drying rice from water-level sensors, cutting water and methane.
twist: Follows irrigation canal water-release schedules and gives Isan-dialect voice updates when it overrides the plan.

name: ASF Farm Sentinel
idea: Watches pig-farm mortality logs and nearby outbreak reports, triggering biosecurity lockdown steps when risk rises.
twist: Raises the risk level automatically when trucks from outbreak provinces are scheduled, common in Thai pig trading.

name: Burn Scar Watch
idea: Reads mock satellite hotspot feeds, predicts smoke drift and alerts village heads before fires spread.
twist: Re-targets alerts when the wind shifts and drafts burn-ban reminders for northern provinces during the haze season.

name: CBAM Evidence Agent
idea: Collects electricity bills and production logs from a Thai exporter and keeps an EU-ready emissions report current.
twist: Recalculates everything when Thailand's grid emission factor or EU rules change, listing which shipments are affected.

name: Harvest Credit Line
idea: Adjusts working-capital credit limits for durian and longan buyers from mock trade data and harvest calendars.
twist: Cuts exposure automatically when farm-gate prices crash or export borders close, and explains each change in plain Thai.

name: เกรงใจ Collector
idea: Runs polite soft-collection on overdue SME invoices via LINE and email, offering instalments before escalating.
twist: Stays inside Thai debt-collection hours and wording rules, and softens tone when a debtor reports hardship.

name: Panic-Sell Guard
idea: Detects panic behaviour in MariBank-style savers during market drops and sends personalised, rule-checked nudges.
twist: Adapts its nudges to each saver's goals and pauses during bank-run rumours, escalating to human advisers.

name: Small-Cap Rumour Desk
idea: Monitors Thai small-cap stock news and filings and updates an analyst note when a claim appears in investor chats.
twist: Checks LINE-group pump rumours against SET filings and flags likely manipulation instead of repeating hype.

name: รถจมน้ำ Claim Agent
idea: Assesses flood-damaged cars from photos and water-line marks, pre-approving simple claims and flagging fraud.
twist: Shifts to surge mode after big floods, triaging thousands of claims and catching photos reused from earlier disasters.

name: Phone Crack Fixer
idea: Coordinates insurer, repair shop and courier when a buyer cracks a phone bought with Shopee device protection.
twist: Re-books another repair shop automatically when parts are out of stock, keeping the buyer's promised return date.

name: Flight Delay Auto-Payout
basedOn: AI Insurance Chatbot Platform (Team Rep Monkeys)
idea: Reasons through a travel policy and pays delay claims as soon as airport data shows a qualifying delay.
twist: Handles rebooked flights and Don Mueang-to-Suvarnabhumi switches by recalculating eligibility before paying.

name: Reusable Box Loop
idea: Schedules rider pickups of reusable ShopeeFood containers, batching returns into existing delivery routes.
twist: Re-plans pickups when riders are scarce in rain, and rewards users with coins tied to Shopee games.

name: ยาครบ Pill Routine
idea: Checks photos of an elder's pill organiser against the prescription and alerts family about missed or wrong doses.
twist: Updates the plan automatically when a new hospital prescription slip is photographed, flagging drug changes for the pharmacist.

name: ยายสั่งได้ Voice Shopper
idea: Lets an elder order groceries on Shopee by voice in Thai dialect, completing checkout within a family-set budget.
twist: Picks safe substitutes when items run out and calls the family before anything over budget or unfamiliar ships.

name: Footpath Navigator
idea: Guides blind pedestrians along Bangkok footpaths with a chest phone camera and voice instructions.
twist: Re-routes around street vendors, parked motorbikes and night markets that appear and vanish by time of day.

name: Deaf Rider Relay
idea: Handles customer calls for deaf delivery riders, converting speech to text and sign and replying on their behalf.
twist: Answers routine questions autonomously and switches to sign video for tricky ones, like a gated condo entry.

name: Sorting Lift Coach
idea: Camera scores worker lifting posture at parcel sorting centres and rotates workers between stations when risk accumulates.
twist: Changes rotation rules when peak volume hits during mega sales, so speed never overrides injury limits.

name: Adaptive Rider Academy
basedOn: Team Road Runners police training simulator
idea: Generates riding scenarios targeted at each rider's weak habits from mock telematics and tracks improvement.
twist: Scenarios include Bangkok flash floods and motorbike U-turns, updating the curriculum after each real near-miss.

name: Condo Night Guard
idea: Watches condo CCTV, separating real threats from cats, riders and residents, and alerts the guard only when needed.
twist: Adapts thresholds when lights fail or rain hits and logs delivery riders separately to cut false alarms.

name: Work Permit Watchdog
idea: Tracks migrant workers' visa and work-permit expiry, prepares renewal documents and notifies employers in advance.
twist: Re-checks every case when cabinet resolutions change rules for Myanmar, Lao and Cambodian workers, in their own languages.

name: TCAS Answer Desk
idea: Answers students' LINE and Facebook questions about university admission from official announcements and FAQs.
twist: Detects when a TCAS round date or rule changes, re-indexes and marks stale answers instead of repeating them.

name: Border School Tutor
idea: Runs an offline tutor on cheap hardware in border schools, syncing progress whenever internet returns.
twist: Switches between Thai and Karen explanations per student and adapts lessons when connectivity drops for days.

name: Mock Exam Re-Planner
idea: Builds a study plan and mock exams for Thai university entrance tests and re-plans after every result.
twist: Detects reading-difficulty signs in handwritten answers and adapts plans for students who may have dyslexia.

name: Diamond Budget Guard
idea: A parent-set agent manages a child's Garena diamond top-up budget and explains spending as a story.
twist: Adjusts to limited-time skin events and suspicious top-up links, pausing purchases and teaching why.

name: RoV Boost Ring Finder
idea: Analyses login and match graphs to find account-boosting and account-trading rings in mobile esports.
twist: Adapts when rings rotate devices or VPNs, linking them to Facebook groups selling ranked accounts.

name: Toxic Voice Moderator
idea: Listens to in-game voice chat in real time and mutes or warns players for harassment and threats.
twist: Learns new Thai gamer slang weekly, so trash talk is allowed but threats and slurs are caught.

name: Live Claim Police
idea: Watches Shopee Live streams in real time and warns hosts the moment they make banned health or alcohol-ad claims.
twist: Updates its rule set when Thai FDA or alcohol-control rules change, and auto-mutes repeat violations.

name: Photo Theft Hunter
idea: Scans marketplaces for sellers using a shop's own product photos and files IP reports automatically.
twist: Catches cropped, re-coloured and watermark-removed copies of OTOP product photos, holding borderline cases for the owner.

name: ละคร Trend Autopilot
idea: Detects items trending from Thai dramas, creates matching bundles and adjusts stock across a seller's shop.
twist: Ramps down orders as soon as buzz fades after the finale, avoiding dead stock.

name: SME Grant Hunter
idea: Monitors Thai SME grant and loan programs daily, matches them to the business and drafts applications.
twist: Re-checks eligibility when criteria or deadlines change and warns before the business misses a window.
